verdict.rationale: Asking whether user data may be used for AI training is a fair privacy question for a service that collects personal data through online accounts and filings, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or statement about AI training use of customer data. The FOIA/Privacy Act request API is an adjacent records-access feature, and the robots/llms.txt bot-walls concern crawler access, not training on user data; neither counts.
